doubts: (1) Amount: the driver contests 4.50 (the whole fee), but POL-NS-07 pays 80% of the net fee (3.60); a reader treating the driver's claim as a refund of the contested sum would rule FULL_REFUND 4.50 - I reject that because POL-NS-10(g) routes the payout through POL-NS-07. (2) Ruling value: POL-GEN-03's party-relative NO_ACTION example (driver-filed dispute over an already-reversed fee) could tempt NO_ACTION/null; that example covers an unsupported driver claim, whereas here the claim is supported, so DRIVER_COMPENSATION. (3) Whether the rider is to be re-charged after the support refund: POL-NS-10(g) says the fee 'stands' and POL-GEN-03 calls driver compensation 'platform-funded or fee-funded'; the ruling fixes only the driver's 3.60, and recovery from the rider is an execution matter not expressed in amount_sgd. (4) Dwell start: 19:30:50 (16.0 m, moving 5 km/h) vs 19:31:00 (first stationary fix) gives 280 s or 270 s; both exceed 180 s, so the outcome does not turn on it.
